summary: Fun puzzle game for the whole family, more than 140 puzzles!
description:
If you or your children like fun kids games and free jigsaw puzzles, you will LOVE Super Puzzle!

This free kids game works like a real jigsaw puzzle for kids. When you select a piece it stays on the board even if you place it incorrectly, and you can move the piece until it slides to the correct place. Your progress is automatically saved so you can take a break whenever you want.

These relaxing puzzles feature beautiful pictures and a fun reward when the image is completed. The kids puzzles include unicorns, dragons, dinosaurs and other fun scenes, while the rewards include balloons, fruits, snowflakes and many more surprises!

In this offline game with colorful scenes you can also choose whether to use 6, 9, 12, 16, 30, 56 or 72 pieces to adjust the difficulty depending on age and skill.

Features: 
- Enjoy playing fun free kids games
- Rewards when you finish each picture
- Multiple difficulties, make it easy for kids and challenging for adults
- Create jigsaw puzzles with your own photos
- Save your favorite images to your photo library
- Play offline without Internet
- App updated for 2023

The app includes 5 collections of free puzzle games to download!
- Collection 2, a mix of fun images
- Fairytales, with dragons, princesses, mermaids and more
- Vehicles, with cars, trains, trucks and more
- Halloween, a scary mix of pumpkins, ghosts and typical things in a Halloween game
- Christmas, a mix with Santa Claus and other classic Xmas images

For more relaxing puzzle games try out our other fun and free educational apps for kids and adults!
